_note: 示例课程数据（SAMPLE DATA），仅供演示，请以学校官方课程表为准并自行核对修改。你可以自由增删课程条目，改完后重新运行 build_kb.py 即可。

courses.description_zh: 介绍程序设计的基本概念，包括变量、控制结构、函数、数组与基础算法，使用 Python 语言教学，是计算机专业的基础入门课。
courses.description_en: Introduces basic programming concepts: variables, control structures, functions, arrays and elementary algorithms, taught in Python. A foundation course for computing students.
courses.remarks: 适合零基础学生；建议一年级修读。

courses.description_zh: 讲授常用数据结构（链表、栈、队列、树、图、哈希表）及其算法应用，强调时间复杂度分析与上机实现。
courses.description_en: Covers fundamental data structures (lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hash tables) and their algorithmic applications, with emphasis on complexity analysis and implementation.
courses.remarks: 后续算法、AI 课程的重要先修。

courses.description_zh: 以 Java/C++ 讲授面向对象思想：类与对象、继承、多态、接口、设计原则及小型项目实践。
courses.description_en: Teaches object-oriented thinking in Java/C++: classes, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, design principles and a mini-project.

courses.description_zh: 涵盖关系模型、SQL、数据库设计（ER 模型与范式）、事务与并发控制、索引与查询优化。
courses.description_en: Covers the relational model, SQL, database design (ER modeling and normalisation), transactions and concurrency control, indexing and query optimisation.

courses.description_zh: 讲授进程与线程、CPU 调度、内存管理、文件系统与死锁处理，含 Linux 上机实验。
courses.description_en: Covers processes and threads, CPU scheduling, memory management, file systems and deadlock handling, with Linux lab exercises.

courses.description_zh: 分治、动态规划、贪心、图算法与 NP 完全性入门，重点训练算法设计与复杂度证明。
courses.description_en: Divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, graph algorithms and an introduction to NP-completeness; emphasises algorithm design and complexity proofs.
courses.remarks: 对求职笔试和深造都重要。

courses.description_zh: 软件开发全流程：需求分析、UML 建模、设计模式、测试与项目管理，含团队项目。
courses.description_en: The full software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, UML modelling, design patterns, testing and project management, with a team project.

courses.title_en: Legal, Ethical, Security and Social Issues in Computing
courses.title_zh: 计算中的法律、伦理、安全与社会议题
courses.description_zh: 讨论计算技术相关的法律、伦理、隐私、安全与社会责任议题，以案例研讨为主。
courses.description_en: Discusses legal, ethical, privacy, security and social-responsibility issues in computing, mainly through case studies.

courses.prerequisites: COMP2011；建议具备 Python 基础
courses.description_zh: 覆盖搜索（启发式/A*）、知识表示、专家系统、机器学习与博弈论等 AI 核心主题，含小组项目（如领域聊天机器人开发）。
courses.description_en: Covers core AI topics: search (heuristic/A*), knowledge representation, expert systems, machine learning and game theory; includes a group project such as domain-specific chatbot development.

courses.description_zh: 监督/无监督学习、模型评估、决策树、神经网络、SVM 与集成方法，含编程作业。
courses.description_en: Supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, decision trees, neural networks, SVMs and ensemble methods, with programming assignments.

courses.description_zh: 词法/句法分析、语言模型、文本分类、序列标注与 Transformer 基础，含课程项目。
courses.description_en: Lexical/syntactic analysis, language models, text classification, sequence labelling and Transformer basics, with a course project.

courses.prerequisites: 高年级学生；需完成大部分专业核心课
courses.description_zh: 学生团队在企业/导师指导下完成一个完整的软件或研究项目，涵盖需求、设计、实现与答辩。
courses.description_en: Student teams complete a full software or research project under industry/academic supervision, covering requirements, design, implementation and defence.
courses.remarks: 学分较高，注意与实习时间冲突。

general_info.content_zh: 每学期的加退选（add/drop）通常在第一、二周进行，学生可在系统内自行调整课程，之后需获得任课老师及学系批准。选课前建议确认课程先修要求、时间冲突与学分上限。
general_info.content_en: The add/drop period is usually in the first two weeks of each semester; students can adjust courses online themselves, after which approval from the instructor and department is required. Before selecting courses, check prerequisites, timetable clashes and credit limits.

general_info.content_zh: 一般每学年需修满学校规定的学分方可正常升级；毕业需满足专业必修、专业选修与通识教育的学分要求，具体以学系最新课程大纲为准。
general_info.content_en: Students normally need to complete the required credits each year to progress; graduation requires fulfilling credit requirements of compulsory major subjects, major electives and general education, per the latest programme scheme.

general_info.content_zh: 多数高阶课程要求先修课成绩达标。若未满足先修要求但认为自己具备同等能力，可向学系申请豁免（waiver），由课程负责人审批。
general_info.content_en: Most advanced courses require a pass in prerequisite subjects. Students who believe they have equivalent competence may apply to the department for a prerequisite waiver, subject to the course leader's approval.
